decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant) in order to generate large amounts of mana quickly. This allows the player to cast powerful threats such as Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also includes control elements like Oblivion Stone and Dismember to deal with opponent's threats. The inclusion of The One Ring and Boseiju, Who Endures provides additional flexibility and protection for the deck's game plan.

The main concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 Control - UrzaTron deck is to assemble the Urza lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate massive amounts of mana and cast powerful threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine. The deck focuses on controlling the board with cards like Oblivion Stone and Dismember while using Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying to find the Urza lands quickly. Karn, the Great Creator is also a key card in the deck, providing utility and disruption to the opponent's strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells and removal spells, while also utilizing powerful creatures like Scion of Draco and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure and secure the win. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help to protect the board and maintain control. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Expressive Iteration and Preordain to ensure consistency in drawing the necessary cards. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's color requirements and provide flexibility in casting spells.

The deck focuses on quickly gaining life through Martyr of Sands and utilizing cards like Abiding Grace and Reprieve to protect the player's life total. It also includes cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Skyclave Apparition to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck has a mix of removal spells and disruptive elements to keep the opponent off balance while steadily building up resources and maintaining a strong defensive position. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggro threats and life gain synergies.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the UrzaTron lands - Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine - in order to generate massive amounts of mana to cast powerful threats like Wurmcoil Engine, Karn, the Great Creator, and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. The deck also includes various cards to help ramp up quickly, find the necessary pieces, and disrupt the opponent's strategies, making it a versatile and resilient control deck in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Scion of Draco using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. Leyline of Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact help protect your creatures and disrupt your opponent's strategy. With a mix of fetch lands to ensure mana fixing and graveyard manipulation, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with big creatures. Additionally, cards like Solitude and Bone Shards provide removal and disruption to control the game until the combo can be assembled.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient instant and sorcery spells to control the board while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce, while also dealing direct damage with Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Expressive Iteration and Preordain to dig deeper into the deck and find key pieces. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on casting free spells and utilizing cascade effects to quickly swarm the board with powerful creatures and spells. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Ardent Plea to cascade into high-impact spells such as Crashing Footfalls and Lórien Revealed, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and card advantage. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help to protect the board, while cards like Subtlety and Force of Negation provide additional disruption against opposing strategies.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deploy threats and pressure the opponent using efficient and versatile creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also utilizes a mix of countermagic and removal spells to protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to smooth out draws and generate card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to win the game through aggressive creature combat and spell-based disruption.

The deck focuses on quickly getting Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. It also utilizes instant reanimation spells like Ephemerate and Solitude to bring back powerful creatures like Territorial Kavu and Scion of Draco. The combo potential is maximized with cards like Leyline Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact to control the board and protect key pieces. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and combo off for a quick win.

The deck focuses on utilizing cascade mechanics to quickly deploy threats onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. By cascading into powerful creatures like Crashing Footfalls and Shardless Agent, as well as disruptive spells like Subtlety and Force of Negation, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Leyline of the Guildpact helps to support the deck's multicolored strategy, making it easier to cast the various spells and creatures in the deck. With a mix of ramp, removal, and card advantage, the deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can establish their own strategy.

The deck focuses on assembling the Colossus Hammer combo by using equipment like Giver of Runes, Stoneforge Mystic, and Puresteel Paladin to equip Colossus Hammer for a massive threat. Urza's Saga helps find the necessary pieces for the combo quickly. The deck also incorporates protection cards like Shadowspear and Burrenton Forge-Tender to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. By combining fast mana generation with efficient equipment tutoring, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a powerful, game-ending combo.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure early on. It also includes spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to deal with opposing threats. The deck aims to control the board with Counterspells and disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a steady stream of threats. By combining aggressive creatures with versatile spells, this deck seeks to overwhelm opponents and secure a fast victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to create a toolbox of options that can be accessed through cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. The goal is to assemble specific combinations of creatures to generate powerful effects, such as sacrificing creatures for value with Yawgmoth, the Thran Physician or creating a loop of recursion with Grist, the Hunger Tide. The deck has a strong emphasis on creature synergy and efficient mana usage to create powerful board states and win conditions.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures with high power and toughness, backed up by efficient removal spells and tribal support cards. The goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with fast and powerful creatures, while using cards like Tribal Flames and Leyline of the Guildpact to further increase the damage output. Stubborn Denial provides protection against removal spells or counters, allowing the deck to maintain pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to win the game through early aggression and efficient use of resources.

This deck focuses on rapidly deploying threats and disrupting opponents with cards like Thoughtseize and Galvanic Blast. It utilizes The Underworld Cookbook as a key piece to generate value, enabling various synergies with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar. The deck also includes a diverse range of creatures and artifact-based removal to maintain pressure on opponents. Jegantha, the Wellspring provides an additional source of mana and flexibility to the deck's game plan, enhancing its aggressive and disruptive elements.
